days.intro: Launch season. Operators need parts on the pad, not in a spreadsheet. Pack them right, ship them fast.
Priority orders today: a launch window waits for nobody, and neither do these customers.
Sensors and solar panels crack if you look at them wrong. Bubble wrap before they go in the box.
The belt keeps stopping and nobody trusts it. Pull the lever, keep shipping. Two Mini Sats in stock!
Every operator wants parts before the launch window closes. It is going to be a long, loud day.
